          type: string

          maxLength: 255

          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'

          description: >-

Implemented the household-duplicate rule for `POST /api/owners`: a create is rejected with **409** when another owner has the same `lastName` **and** the same `address` (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace), unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

Changes, following the OfficeFloor function-injection conventions in AGENTS.md:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a write-only `sharesHousehold` boolean to the `OwnerFields` schema so the flag binds on the request body without appearing in responses.

2. **`EnsureUniqueHousehold`** (new function class) — reads the validated `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` and the `OwnerRepository`; skips when `sharesHousehold` is `true`, otherwise normalizes (`strip` → collapse whitespace → lower-case) both `lastName` and `address` and throws `DuplicateHouseholdException` on a match against any existing owner. Mirrors the existing `EnsureUniqueTelephone` pattern.

3. **`DuplicateHouseholdException`** (checked) + **`DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler`** — the handler responds 409 with `{"errors":["lastName","address"]}`, matching the telephone handler's shape.

4. **Escalation YAML** — `officefloor/escalation/…DuplicateHouseholdException.yml` wires the handler.

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted `ensureUniqueHousehold` (governed by `transaction`) into the pipeline after `ensureUniqueTelephone`, before `build`, so the check runs after validation and before anything is saved.

The three new Cp10 tests (reject same lastName+address, allow different address, allow with `sharesHousehold`) pass, and all pre-existing checkpoints (Cp01–Cp09) remain green.
